item.title: GovBrief Today #650
item.description: An Army sentinel at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier told Pete Hegseth’s group to be quiet today. It was Veterans Day in a country at war, and Donald Trump had already left the wreath-laying ceremony. The plaza at the tomb was empty except for the soldier on guard. Hegseth stayed on the steps above it and posed arm in arm with his wife and two others for a photographer. Then he waved more of his aides down and they lined up for a second picture. The laughing started as that second group broke up. “All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times,” the soldier called out. A day earlier, nine members of the Kennedy family had asked a federal judge to stop Trump’s 250-foot arch because its shadow would fall on their relatives’ graves in that same cemetery. Two of them called it hallowed ground. For Pete Hegseth, his wife, and his aides, it was a backdrop. I’ve emailed 9,899 stories over 650 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can’t show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. NEW: Zoom In is now live! item.title: COUNT IT!: Democrat Scott Colom wins election to U.S. Senate from Mississippi
item.description: Democrat Scott Colom won election Wednesday to the U.S. Senate representing Mississippi, defeating Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith. Colom will be Mississippi’s first Black senator since the post-Civil War Reconstruction era. His victory also offers Democrats an unexpected boost in their effort to win control of the Senate. A local prosecutor, he waged an aggressive campaign to take advantage of a tough national environment for Republicans and the fact that Mississippi has a larger share of Black voters than any other state. Hyde-Smith, a staunch ally of President Donald Trump, was trying to win her second full term. She was first appointed to fill a vacancy and then won a 2018 special election. The Associated Press declared Colom the winner at 5:58 p.m. EST. https://www.sfgate.com/news/politics/article/democrat-scott-colom-wins-election-to-u-s-senate-22526013.php

item.title: Christopher judge says he doesn’t understand why shows based on successful games don’t bring back the original actors and writers
item.description: Christopher Judge believes Hollywood should involve more of the original actors and writers when adapting successful video games 00 Although he had praise for Pedro Pascal's performance in The Last of Us, he questioned why the game cast was not used for scenes that were recreated so closely. Judge also criticised Amazon's God of War series for leaving out writers from the games, saying, "These guys have been immersed in this world for 20 years. But someone's going to know better?"

item.title: Happy Veterans Day/Remembrance Day
item.description:
Here's to this kid, and every other kid who used the military to get out of their hometowns and got used in return. Veterans Day is to celebrate those of us who came back, physically, at least.
In other countries, Nov 11th is Remembrance Day. So to those who observe that, tiny octopus remembers you and yours. In Flanders fields the poppies blow Between the crosses, row on row, That mark our place; and in the sky The larks, still bravely singing, fly Scarce heard amid the guns below. We are the Dead. Short days ago We lived, felt dawn, saw sunset glow, Loved and were loved, and now we lie, In Flanders fields. Take up our quarrel with the foe: To you from failing hands we throw     The torch; be yours to hold it high.     If ye break faith with us who die We shall not sleep, though poppies grow         In Flanders fields.
